title: Architecture-candidate activation

allowed_after_activation: define a bounded candidate family for assurance scoring and evidence features
inventory eligible open-weight or otherwise fully zero-founder-cost locally runnable base-model candidates
verify exact model and tokenizer revisions, licenses, release dates, provenance, and known benchmark exposure
verify founder-zero-cost inference and compute paths
prospectively freeze exact base-model, tokenizer, and FHIR-agent-strategy identities before post-D3 query-trace qualification
retain every candidate attempt, rejection, and negative result
produce the frozen trace-producing system identity required by the mandatory post-D3/pre-D4 query-trace gate
forbidden: sealed-final question text, traces, true_answer, proc_query, true_fhir_ids, model outputs, labels, or supervision access
performance-driven model or agent switching after the prospective D3 trace-producing identity freeze
using post-D3 query-trace outcomes to select a different trace-producing model or agent strategy
paid APIs, paid compute, paid cloud, paid datasets, or paid reviewers

candidate_requirements: open-weight or otherwise fully zero-cost locally runnable
license compatible with research release and reproducibility
exact model and tokenizer revisions can be frozen
release date and known benchmark exposure are recorded
fits the compute envelope or has a validated quantized CPU or otherwise zero-founder-cost execution path

compute_policy.larger_candidate_rule: eligible only if D3 proves another reproducible zero-founder-cost path

d3_exit_criteria: candidate family is bounded and mechanically recorded
exact eligible model and tokenizer revisions and provenance are bound
FHIR agent strategy is prospectively frozen
compute, license, release-date, and contamination-risk evidence is recorded
every rejected or blocked candidate remains visible as negative evidence
one prospectively frozen trace-producing base-model plus FHIR-agent-strategy identity exists for the mandatory immediate post-D3/pre-D4 query-trace gate
no D4 training or objective fitting occurred

mandatory_post_d3_pre_d4_gate.custodian: founder-authorized blind development-only query-trace custodian from Issue #126
mandatory_post_d3_pre_d4_gate.required_result: every observed normalized FHIR query/search pattern is exercised and either supported or recorded as a behavior-changing blocker
